title: Aura API request
description: What Aura sends to the endpoint on every fetch. `POST` / `PUT` / `PATCH` carry it as the JSON body, `GET` / `DELETE` as query parameters (`requestMethod` config, default `POST`). `page` and `paginate` are always present; the rest appear only while the matching feature is active. Sent alongside the `Content-Type: application/json`, `Accept: application/json` and `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` headers, plus `Authorization: Bearer …` or `X-Site-Token: …` when a `siteToken` is configured.

paginate.description: Items per page — the page size chosen in the toolbar.

sortable.description: Active sorts, in the order the user added them. Omitted while nothing is sorted.

field.description: Field to sort by — the header cell’s `reference`, if it declares one, otherwise its `field`.

searchable.description: Active per-column searches. A term search sends `term` (with `exact`); a range search (`between`) sends `min` / `max` instead, either of which may be `null` for an open end. Omitted while nothing is searched.

term.description: Search term. Absent on a range search.

exact.description: Match the whole value rather than a substring.

min.description: Lower bound of a range search; `null` means unbounded.

max.description: Upper bound of a range search; `null` means unbounded.

filterable.description: Active column filters. Omitted while nothing is filtered.

values.description: Values selected in the filter dropdown; the row matches if it equals any of them.

globalSearch.description: Term from the toolbar’s global search box, covering the fields listed in `header.settings.searchableItems`. Omitted while the box is empty.

selected.description: Ids of the rows currently selected. Attached at request time only, and omitted when the selection is empty — changing the selection does not itself trigger a fetch.
